reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited clause in p0001 expressly states no exclusive arrangement is created and that Customer remains free to offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties — this meets the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered text is identical to the original.

Rationale correctly characterizes the remaining 'exclusive'/'sole' hits (non-exclusive license in Customer's favor, exclusive jurisdiction, trademark ownership, no third-party beneficiaries) as non-triggering, and the deterministic check confirms no sole-supplier/all-requirements obligation remains.
